logic.entry: Once per UTC week on the specified weekday, deterministic schedule known at least 60 seconds beforehand; buy at 00:01 UTC minute open.
logic.exit: Sell at 00:01 UTC after fixed holding_days; retry each minute after a rejected exit; no overlapping/re-entry before exit.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; use available cash; long-only unlevered spot; no transfers or interest.
logic.time_availability: Calendar event is known before its scheduled minute; all price-driven cost inputs are lagged completed-day observations.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.citation: The day of the week effect in the cryptocurrency market (Finance Research Letters, 2019)
sources.use: Motivation only. This experiment is not a replication; older findings do not establish a current edge.

sources.citation: Bitcoin time-of-day, day-of-week and month-of-year effects in returns and trading volume (2019)
